_doc: Hero resolve level (0-6) and expedition difficulty. Rules: scripts/domain/resolve_system.gd. Spec: docs/01-core-systems-spec.md §6.

resolve._radiant_doc: Modo Pura Vida (DD Radiant mode, picked in the hub): a faster XP curve and heroes accept expeditions up to radiant_extra_levels below their range.
resolve._resist_doc: Status resistance points (%) gained per resolve level (resist_categories in statuses.json).

_skill_ranks_doc: Casa Comunal de Oficios (doc 02 §4, doc 04 §3.3). Every hero skill has a rank 1..max_rank, bought one step at a time. costs and min_resolve are indexed by the target rank (index 0 and 1 unused). per_rank is added once for every rank above 1 and only to fields the skill already has: damage_min/damage_max (attacks), skill_accuracy, skill_crit (crit points, attacks only), heal_min/heal_max, stress_relief, status_chance (applies/self_applies chances below 1, capped at 1), status_value (applies/self_applies values above 0). A skill may set rank_bonus in skills.json with the same keys to replace per_rank. Rules: scripts/domain/skill_ranks.gd.
_region_doc: Each region JSON has a region_level (doc 05 §4 order: Sótanos 0, Cañaverales/Bosque 1, Pueblo Fantasma 2, Ruinas Volcánicas 3, Portal 4). It adds to the picked difficulty: expedition level and the hero range move up by region_level (capped at 6), and enemies/pay/XP grow per region level as below.
_difficulty_doc: level = expedition level shown to the player. Heroes above max_level refuse to go; heroes below min_level are under-leveled (start stress + extra stress taken per level short). xp = Resolve XP each survivor earns on a completed expedition. enemy_hp/enemy_dmg multiply, enemy_accuracy and enemy_resist (status resist points) add; values follow doc 05 §4. reward multiplies pay.
